step_1_scope: field content, finite joint action, exact variations, scalar boundary response and limiting target

field_content.T: inherited irrotational dust potential, dimension length
field_content.w: inherited integrated dust density, dimension action; atom plus positive sector
field_content.Phi: additional real scalar field, dimension sqrt(action)/length; not T and not an unconstrained dust fluctuation

parameters.ell: positive discreteness length, not numerically fixed
parameters.v: ell^4, geometric volume weight independent of w
parameters.mu2: nonnegative inverse Compton length squared, not numerically fitted

action.B: unmodified unsmoothed 4D BD operator, declared finite candidate; no stability or continuum theorem for this joint model
action.dependence: H_C depends on C, ell, mu; not directly on T or w
action.extra_scalar_boundary_action: none for the chosen pair action with fixed external scalar values; its full boundary reaction is retained

boundary_condition_for_variation: fixed values on an explicitly chosen exterior set; adequacy as physical Cauchy collar and wavefunction projection deferred to step 2
atom_extension: same scalar action at w=0 and w>0; this does not select stratum wavefunctions or a physical quantum measure
decoupling_note: no direct coupling parameter exists in this minimal candidate; multiplying the entire scalar action by zero is not a qualified matched reference
